trips.route_note: High-speed trains run directly from Nanjing South to Yangzhou in about an hour, with the station connected to the old town by local bus or taxi.
trips.why: Direct high-speed trains take about an hour and the station links to the old town by local bus or taxi.
know: Book train tickets ahead for weekend and holiday travel
Spring and autumn are the most comfortable seasons to walk the old town

trips.route_note: Frequent high-speed trains from Nanjing South reach Zhenjiang in about 30 minutes, then a local bus or short taxi ride goes to the temples and hill sites.
trips.why: Frequent high-speed trains reach Zhenjiang in about 22 minutes, with a short local ride to the hill and temple sites.
know: Jinshan and Beigu Hill sites are spread out, so plan local transport between them

trips.route_note: High-speed trains from Nanjing South reach Chuzhou in roughly 20 minutes, then a local bus or taxi continues to Langya Mountain.
trips.tour_query: Langya Mountain day trip from Nanjing
trips.why: High-speed trains take under an hour, then a local bus or taxi continues to Langya Mountain.
know: Langya Mountain is a half-day outing, so start early
Autumn is a popular season for the mountain scenery

trips.route_note: High-speed trains from Nanjing South take about 20-30 minutes to Ma'anshan, from where local buses reach the riverside and Caishi sites.
see: Pilgrimage to the poetry sites along the Yangtze
